Definition: tranquil; (in a bad sense) careless; abstractly, security
BiblicalUsage: At ease is a dangerous place to be, and this word carries both the rest and the carelessness of it. The psalmist sees the ungodly who prosper in the world and increase in riches, Job says he was at ease but God broke him asunder, and Jeremiah warns a wealthy nation that dwells without care, with neither gates nor bars.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that ease is the most dangerous condition in the Bible, because it makes a man forget that he needs God.
